caption:
Mortgage trouble is creeping up. 🏠

The NY Fed says 1.60% of mortgage balances moved into serious delinquency (90+ days) in Q3. A year ago it was 1.28%.

Still low next to credit cards, but the direction matters.

Have you noticed housing costs squeezing people around you?
